cv.name: Fernanda Palacios
cv.headline: ICU Staff Nurse | Critical Care | Bilingual English–Spanish
cv.summary: Licensed nurse with eight years of hospital experience in Monterrey, the last five in an adult intensive care unit. Postgraduate specialty in critical care and fluent English used daily with international patients.

experience.title: Staff Nurse, Adult Intensive Care Unit
bullets: Care for two to three critically ill patients per shift, including ventilated and post-cardiac surgery patients
Manage vasoactive infusions, arterial lines and central venous catheters
Mentor new graduate nurses during their ICU orientation
Joined the infection control team that reduced central line infections to zero for 11 consecutive months

experience.title: General Ward Nurse
bullets: Medical-surgical care for up to eight patients per shift
Patient and family education at discharge

education.degree: Postgraduate Specialty in Critical Care Nursing

education.details: Social service year 2017 – 2018 at a rural health centre in Linares, N.L.
